name: Oceania Hotels
verdict: Breton hotel brand (Oceania Hotels, hôtels d'origine bretonne) whose hotel companies are chaired by the Branellec family holding F.B.I. (SA, Brest, created 1987). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: registry shows F.B.I.'s conseil d'administration entirely Branellec family (Francois, Gwenola Deguerre-Branellec, Gurvan, Rozenn Dumon-Branellec), and the same board at subsidiary Sofibra. No state or fund stake found → none.
